name: frontier-audit
description: Score repositories against pinned Frontier conformance rules and optionally issue signed, evidence-bound AAR receipts.

interface.longDescription: Score a repository against versioned Frontier conformance rules, bind the result to its Git state, and optionally issue a signed AAR evidence receipt. The plugin safely obtains the exact Frontier Audit SDK when needed, verifies its integrity chain, and runs the deterministic SDK-owned scorer. Receipts distinguish structural verifier separation from organizational independence and default to same-principal attestation, not third-party audit.
defaultPrompt: Use Frontier Audit to audit and attest this repository.
Bootstrap the pinned Frontier Audit SDK and run an evidence-bound audit.
